portal.vendor_source: not established - a bot challenge is served before any portal markup

quirks.summary: Every request gets a 'Bot Verification' page under HTTP 200 - a real challenge, so the automated route stops here.
quirks.detail: Seen 2026-09-30. The status code is 200 and the body is the challenge, so a run that only checks status codes would treat this as a successful fetch of an empty portal. Not defeated, per the skill's rules of engagement.
quirks.workaround: Hand the user the browser link. Note robots.txt separately disallows the document paths.

robots.note: robots.txt allows the portal path but explicitly disallows /document/*/download/ and /document/*/view/ - i.e. the document files themselves.

browser_route.note: Clear the Bot Verification interstitial in a real browser, then search from there.

bot_protection.behaviour: Every request returns a 1,705-byte 'Bot Verification' interstitial under HTTP 200. No portal markup is served behind it, so the vendor could not be fingerprinted. A run that checks only status codes reads this as a successful fetch of an empty portal.

verification.note: New entry. Not retrievable: a 'Bot Verification' interstitial is served under HTTP 200 for every request, so the vendor could not be fingerprinted and no recipe was attempted. Challenge not defeated, per the skill's responsible-use rules.
